purpose: Fresh Gate 3 tranche G ambiguous-follow-up cases that must request clarification instead of guessing.

cases.question: Can I use that one after the battle?

history.content: I'm looking at Onward and Rout on the General.
Onward is a during-Movement Order. Rout is an end-of-Aftermath Order after winning as attacker.

cases.question: Does that one need me to be defending?

history.content: I'm comparing Capitulation and Diplomatic Recognition.
Capitulation requires the Diplomat to be the defender. Diplomatic Recognition requires the Diplomat to be defending a Counterattack.

cases.question: Can that one start as a Special Operation?

history.content: I have Fog of War and Treason in Hand and both have Mission text.
Each may be eligible to start as a normal Mission if its printed Mission requirement is usable.

cases.question: Does that one stop my normal draw?

history.content: I have Margin Loan and Tariffs banked.
Margin Loan has an outstanding-loan restriction. Tariffs changes your normal Draw while it remains banked.

cases.question: If I lose the next battle, does that one reset?

history.content: My selected Rites include Rite of Echoes and Rite of Shattering.
Echoes has a loss interruption before completion. Shattering resolves around the first later-turn battle that reaches dice.
